variables.name: STARTUP_NAME
variables.description: The startup's name.

variables.name: STARTUP_ONE_LINER
variables.description: One sentence on what it is and for whom.

variables.name: STARTUP_DESCRIPTION
variables.description: Stage, license, business model, editions.

variables.name: STARTUP_WEBSITE
variables.description: The website, read only to judge fit.

variables.name: STARTUP_LINKS
variables.description: "Type: URL" lines, read only to judge fit.

variables.name: SECTOR
variables.description: The startup's market, for example "online education". Replaces hard-coded topic lists.

variables.name: CONSTRAINTS
variables.description: Company and founders text from the profile's AI context (tips in constraints-tips.json). One text per startup instead of a preset example. With no text, its line and the line above it are removed.

variables.name: COUNTRY
variables.description: Home country.

variables.name: ENTITY_TYPE
variables.description: Legal form.

variables.name: HOME_REGION
variables.description: Area where in-person events are acceptable.

variables.name: MAX_TARGETS_PER_DAY
variables.description: Daily calendar cap, default 10.

variables.name: TODAY
variables.description: Today's date.

variables.name: TIMEZONE
variables.description: The time zone for all dates and times.

variables.name: TAB
variables.description: The section: MK, PO or FU. The name is kept from earlier prompts.

variables.name: CATEGORY
variables.description: Readable names of the chosen categories.

variables.name: SUBCATEGORY
variables.description: Readable names of the chosen subcategories.

variables.name: TYPE
variables.description: Readable names of the chosen types.

variables.name: SCOPE_DETAILS
variables.description: Descriptions of the chosen taxonomy nodes, so the agent understands the scope.

variables.name: SEARCH_FOCUS
variables.description: What to look for and how to rank it; was the preset part of CONSTRAINTS. Filled from the selected examples, one bullet each.

variables.name: VERIFIED_ACTIVITY
variables.description: What to confirm before adding. Filled from the selected examples, one bullet each.

variables.name: AVOID
variables.description: What to leave out. Filled from the selected examples, one bullet each.

variables.name: SPECIAL_SCHEDULE
variables.description: How to pick the date. Filled from the selected examples, one bullet each.

variables.name: TRACKER_ACCESS
variables.description: How to save results, set by the run mode: the tracker tools in an ACP run; CLI and API steps with a limited agent token when the prompt is copied; a JSON format for chat agents that cannot run commands.
